policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: Reported annualized revenue comes in nearer $50B than $70B
items.summary: Reuters/FT reporting says O told investors annualized revenue was approaching ~$50B at end of September—about $20B below earlier “~$70B” figures driven by a different comparison basis/accounting.

items.headline: O: GPT-6 ships to more ChatGPT tiers via Intelligent UI
items.summary: O rolled out GPT-6 with “Intelligent UI” in ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise immediately, expanding to Free/Go the next day. Focus: interactive UI elements inside responses, with safety framing.

items.headline: O: ChatGPT expands ads with new visual format
items.summary: O introduced a new visual ad format in ChatGPT, with expanded measurement tools and measurement/attribution integrations. Initial testing starts later in the month in the US with an advertiser group.

items.headline: O: SoftBank executes O follow-on third tranche
items.summary: SoftBank says it executed the third and final tranche of its O follow-on investment: $10.0B, completing $30.0B follow-on total. SBG cumulative O investment is $64.6B; ownership ~13%.

items.headline: V: Series D raises $250M at $1.6B valuation
items.summary: Reuters-reported company update: V raised ~$250M in Series D at a $1.6B valuation to scale orbital drug manufacturing in microgravity, with round leadership cited by Reuters reporting.
